sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (15:00), looking to bounce back after their most recent loss. Despite that setback, the league leaders remain on top with 22 points from 10 games and a strong underlying record of seven wins, one draw, and two losses. They then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (15:00) in their second fixture of the week.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host bottom side Widnes Town on 3 October, offering a chance to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth have the midweek advantage, hosting Eccleshall on 7 October before facing Brereton Social on 10 October. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals (currently on a three-game winning streak) travel to Wednesfield Community on 3 October, while Bilston Town, also in strong form, host Crewe on 10 October. Brereton Social play twice this week—hosting Widnes at home on 3 October, then hosting Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October before going away to Allscott Heath on 10 October. Struggling Shawbury United, on a six-game losing run, face Barnton away on 10 October. Other weekend 3 October fixtures include Cheadle Heath Nomads away to Telford Town, Crewe hosting Allscott Heath (who are targeting five wins on the bounce), Market Drayton Town hosting New Mills, and Foley Meir hosting Bilston Town. On 10 October, Alsager Town host Shawbury United, Barnton host Dawley Town, Market Drayton Town host Widnes Town, Sandbach United host Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Telford Town host New Mills.
